tree.heading: Judicial review
tree.text: The appropriate United States district court shall have exclusive jurisdiction over litigation arising under this section 1 involving any redomesticating or redomesticated insurer.

tree.heading: Severability
tree.text: If any provision of this section,1 or the application thereof to any person or circumstances, is held invalid, the remainder of the section,1 and the application of such provision to other persons or circumstances, shall not be affected thereby.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This section, referred to in text, probably should be a reference to this subtitle, meaning subtitle B (§§ 311–316) of title III of Pub. L. 106–102, which is classified generally to this subchapter.
